request.prompt: How much does the Unitree G1 cost?

result.text:
The Unitree G1 starts at $13,500 USD (approximately €11,600) from the manufacturer.

However, the price depends heavily on the version and configuration.

Prices (November 2026)

Version

Approximate price

G1 Basic (manufacturer)

$13,500

G1 Basic (Germany)

€16,999–€27,370

G1 EDU (developer edition)

€37,000+

Advanced EDU configurations

€40,000–€67,000+

Sources: Unitree and German retailer listings.

What do you get?

G1 Basic: Walking, movement demonstrations and basic interaction.

G1 EDU: More development capabilities, programmable functions and additional hardware options.

Advanced EDU: More sophisticated dexterous hands, computing hardware and research capabilities.

Where can you buy one?

Official Unitree shop

Important: Manufacturer prices exclude shipping, taxes and import costs. The EDU version also requires a separate sales enquiry.

Are you interested in buying one to experiment with AI and robotics, use as a personal robot, or develop your own applications? The best version depends considerably on what you want it to do.
